name: Zine Collage
description: A DIY zine on kraft paper: torn pink and black paper, halftone cutouts drawn in code, ransom-note letters each in a different font and colour, translucent tape strips and handwritten notes, all slapped on at a jittery 8 frames a second.
style: Kraft paper (#e2d2b2) with speckles, torn jagged shapes in hot pink, black, white and yellow with short drop shadows, halftone dot-grid subjects, ransom-note titles with each letter in its own font/colour box, tape strips, Caveat handwriting, stop-motion 8 fps slap timing with 1-2 px jitter. Lo-fi beat with vinyl crackle.
